name: [LATE EASTER] Minus Elevation
desc:
Dive as deep as you can into the depths of this roguelike facility avoiding deadly monsters on your way down. What resides at the bottom..?

-[FEATURES]-
Tough AI enemies that increase in difficulty the deeper you go.
Random upgrades that benefit the whole server.
Unique items that change the way you interact with the game.

-[EXPLOITERS WILL BE BANNED]-
Exploiting / Glitch Abuse is not allowed and will result in a tempban.
Repeated offenses will result in a permaban.
